map.检查「资产 = 负债 + 所有者权益」「经营现金流 = 净利润 + 折旧摊销」两: Check two identities: assets = liabilities + equity, and CFO = net income + depreciation.

map.能直接用于正式报表吗？: Can I use it for official statements?
map.不能。模型省略了应收应付、存货、其他损益等科目，仅用于演示与教学；正式报表需按会: No. The model omits receivables, payables, inventory and other gains/losses; it is for demos and teaching only. Official statements must follow accounting standards and be audited.
map.营业成本 = 营业收入 × 成本率；毛利 = 营业收入 − 营业成本；营业利润: Operating cost = revenue x cost ratio; gross profit = revenue - operating cost; operating profit = gross profit - period expenses; income tax = operating profit x tax rate (0 when at a loss); net profit = operating profit - income tax; liabilities = total assets x debt ratio; owners' equity = total assets - liabilities; operating cash flow = net profit + depreciation and amortization; net increase in cash = operating + investing (-capital expenditure) + financing (-dividends).
map.三张报表由同一组输入派生，保证「资产 = 负债 + 所有者权益」与「经营现金流: All three statements derive from the same inputs, so the two cross-checks "assets = liabilities + owners' equity" and "operating cash flow = net profit + depreciation and amortization" always hold; the output is for demonstration and teaching, not an audited statement.
map.营业收入 1000、成本率 65% → 营业成本 650、毛利 350；期间费用:
Revenue 1000, cost ratio 65% → operating cost 650, gross profit 350; period expenses 150 → operating profit 200; tax rate 25% → income tax 50, net profit 150.
Assets 1200, debt ratio 45% → liabilities 540, equity 660 (1200 - 540 - 660 = 0).
Operating cash flow 150 + depreciation 60 = 210; investing -80, financing -30 → net increase in cash 100, closing cash 300 (opening 200).
